Rewards.Label: One special item from Singer's Meadow

Name: Part of the Pack
Description: Illager poachers are hunting down and caging the wolves of the forest.

Name: The Cleric's Apprentice
Description: The villagers of Little Howl are getting sick from eating plants that grew near the sculk. The Cleric's Apprentice had a crazy idea about how to cure the sickness and ran out to gather spider eyes, and now they are missing.

Rewards.Label: One of Mushroom Boots, Mushroom Robe, Mushroom Cap, Mushroom Leggings

Objectives: Bring the satchel to Little Howl

Name: The Trembling Golem
Description: An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be robbed of its soul block and left in the dark Howling Woods.

Name: The Freezing Golem
Description: An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be robbed of its soul block and left in the freezing cold of the Frozen Highlands.

Name: The Sneezing Golem
Description: An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be robbed of its soul block and left in Honeycomb Fields to gather dust.

Name: The Rusting Golem
Description: An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be robbed of its soul block and left soaking wet in Rainy Plains.

Name: Keeper of the Bees
Description: The patches of sculk that have spread from the illager rifts are poisoning the flowers nearby and risk making the poor bees sick.

Rewards.Label: One special item from Honeycomb Fields

Objectives: Find a spot to build beehives
Find a spot to build beehives
Find a spot to build beehives
Find a spot to build beehives

Name: The Creeper Candle Conspiracy
Description: The Farmer is waiting for their friend, the Candlemaker, who has just crafted a new type of candle with explosive qualities and is excited to show it off. However, over the last few days, the Candlemaker has felt as though someone is spying on them, planning to steal the candles.

Name: The Fight at the End of the Tunnel
Description: The Miner escaped after being held captive and forced to dig a tunnel.

Rewards.Label: One of Steel Wool Boots, Steel Wool Sweater, Steel Wool Cap, Steel Wool Leggings

Objectives: Find the door to the passageway

Name: Illager Intelligence
Description: The Librarian was looking for some lavatory reading in the library towers, which are still occupied by illagers. There, they overheard the illagers discussing something they were looking for in the old ruins, where they say the Arch-Illager once used to conduct experiments.

Name: Gone Fishing
Description: The Fisher left their fishing equipment in the ice caves and now the illagers have set up their new base in there.

Name: Rage of the Sifters
Description: The Singer is worried about the sifters that roam the wild meadows nearby. They have been driven mad by the presence of the invasive illagers.

Rewards.Label: One of Sifter Boots, Sifter Robe, Sifter Hood, Sifter Leggings

Name: Wobble Run
Description: The Echo Golem was watching over the wobbles when they all got scared and bounced away.
Objectives: Lead the wobble to the Echo Golem

Name: A Friend till the End
Description: On your quest to destroy the portal, the Scared Golem sacrificed their soul block for you.

Name: Lonesome in Lullaby Hills
Description: The illagers stole all the soul blocks from the echo golems of Lullaby Hills and took them to their fortress on the other side of the chasm. Maybe the soul blocks are still there.

Name: Breaking Camps
Description: The illagers are setting up camps too close to the Echo Den and they keep bothering the golems and chasing them around.

Name: A Dip in Ichor Springs
Description: With all the disharmony lately, some echo golems were growing weak and wobbled off towards the ichor springs to recharge their soul blocks. Three of them have now gone missing, and their friend worries they may have run out of power on the way.

Rewards.Label: One of Oracle Sandals, Oracle Mantle, Oracle Crown, Oracle Tights

Name: Recycling Your Monstrosity
Description: The Inventor in Puddle Pond wants you to pursue the illagers who scavenged the Supreme Evoker's Monstrosity and stop them from transporting the copper out of Rainy Plains.
Objectives: Bring the copper to the Inventor

Name: Wildflower Warrior
Description: A villager in Puddle Pond has asked you to look for the Gatherer who still hasn't returned from picking flowers.

Name: Illegal Illager Trials
Description: The villagers of Puddle Pond have heard rumors that a group of illagers have continued the Supreme Evoker's soul corrupting experiments. Except now, with no more monsters or villagers to use as test subjects, they have started experimenting on themselves!
